rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses sponsored or approved by ADA and affiliates, ADHA and affiliates, Academy of General Dentistry, American Academy of Dental Hygiene, National Dental Association, American Association of Dental Boards, CODA-accredited dental schools, armed services/VA dental departments, recognized specialty societies, ACCME; courses approved for dentists also count
rules.new_licensee_rule: Exempt at the first renewal (CPR/BLS still required).
rules.carryover: Not allowed for the 72 h awarded for the local anesthesia course; late hours (completed by August of the next year) do not count toward the next period.
rules.audit_note: Board page: all licensees report CE in CE Broker by December 31. Keep records 3 calendar years; Board may request documentation at random.
rules.notes: 12 h personally attended clinical + 8 h clinical in person, online or correspondence (with a test). BLS must be kept current (AHA/Red Cross, not fully online); earns 3 h. Completing the Board's local anesthesia course earns 72 h for that period.
rules.legal_basis: La. Admin. Code tit. 46, pt. XXXIII, §1613

topics.who: Current BLS (AHA/Red Cross, not fully online), also at first renewal; earns 3 h
